author: Charles Mays
title: Vanderbilt baseball takes 15-1 win over Lipscomb in midweek matchup - NewsBreak
text:
By Charles Mays ,
20 hours ago Vanderbilt baseball made a quick drive to visit the Lipscomb for a midweek game at Ken Dugan Field in Nashville, Tenn., leaving with a 15-1 win. Rustan Rigdon (2-for-2, HR, 2 R, BB, 3 RBI) hit a solo home run in the second inning for his fourth of the season. Logan Johnstone (4-for-5, HR, 2 R, 4 RBI) also hit a homer in this one for his ninth of the season, and Aukai Kea hit a pinch-hit home run for his third homer of the season. Read full article
